agent_priors_used: General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: when every comparator sits at the correctness ceiling, a treatment cannot demonstrate a success or request-count advantage, so non-ceiling dynamic range must be certified arithmetically before funding full comparison runs.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: a capability gate (can the chosen endpoint emit a valid action and complete the minimal multi-step task at all) should be resolved before paying for a multi-arm behavioural comparison, because a model that cannot produce a parseable action renders every arm equally uninformative.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: shipping a mechanism without an executable carrier and a companion known-negative refusal path yields a paper capability, not a product; the promotion must go through the sanctioned shipped path rather than a manual file copy.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: repeated packets invalidated by the same missing prerequisite (here an empty sampling frame / unattainable pre-freeze certificate) indicate a design/control-plane defect to repair once, rather than a research question to keep re-asking in the same form.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: a lane repeatedly measuring one claim under a local-attractor flag deserves an outside-view reset, but a flag is not a quota and continuation is correct when the inherited question is still the highest expected-value one.

General prior, explicitly NOT SPIDER evidence: an incomplete comparison is worse than a slower one - removing a shared blocker once (shipped carrier, non-ceiling bank, capable driver) dominates repeatedly regenerating inconclusive benchmarks around the same absent prerequisite.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION. The legacy procedural-reuse precedents are literal/scripted, not parameterized-shipped: P2-REPLAY-COST (artifact 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b, 1.002x on matched tasks; guard: do not frame scripted replay as real-agent economics), P2-BLIND-COMPOSITION (artifact 017a80aeb9a6759c8f6913a37031ff1616ec1bda, G-H2 3/3 vs 0/3 under weak baselines and keyword/oracle dependence) and P2-MIND2WEB (exact human route 6/176; distinct-and-decomposable structure). None of these landed an identifier-general mechanism into a shipped executable path with a known-negative refusal certificate. B1 is therefore a materially distinct extension: promote the audited parameterized carrier via the sanctioned path and prove positive execution plus a known-negative refusal. Not a duplicate of legacy replay, and not a premature re-run of the economics benchmark.
allocation.question: Can the audited parameterized inherited carrier be landed into the shipped kernel through the sanctioned promotion path - so that after promotion the shipped execution path contains a concrete parameterized mechanism that an inherited procedure visibly instantiates and executes, together with a companion known-negative refusal certificate - such that blocker B1 is satisfied and the pre-freeze executable mechanism required by readiness condition (1) exists, rather than once more running the four-arm economics benchmark on a kernel that still emits literals below the execution threshold?
allocation.rationale: This is the audit's first dependency and the highest-leverage product action available. B1 is verified at source: src/spider/kernel.py contains only literal distill() and a candidate at confidence 0.5 against a default 0.8 execution threshold, while distill_parameterized() is absent, so the shipped path has no executable treatment to benchmark. The audited experimental carrier (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064: distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute live and causally attributable, 12/15 new identifiers executed, 0/15 for the literal incumbent at its frozen confidence gate, credential-free HTTP substrate outside the synthetic fixture) exists but is not shipped. Centrally, I explicitly do NOT fund the four-arm COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL/SPIDER benchmark this cycle: readiness conditions (2) and (3) do not hold, so Product is funded only to land the carrier and its known-negative refusal path through the sanctioned promotion route. This supersedes the inherited proposal to run the benchmark on a credential-free endpoint, which is blocked by B2 and B3.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER's central unresolved question is still whether a real external LLM agent benefits from inherited procedures/parameterized mechanisms at lower fully-loaded cost per successful task, and that question is gated by three verified blockers rather than by any one lane's local frontier: B1 - no promoted executable parameterized carrier (src/spider/kernel.py still lacks distill_parameterized() and emits literal candidates at confidence 0.5, below the 0.8 default execution threshold); B2 - no non-ceiling task bank (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 and EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 both hit cold/retrieval correctness 1.0 on the deterministic credential-free substrates, so a SPIDER treatment cannot show a success or request advantage); B3 - no proven same-model driver (credential-free local 3B/7B models failed the minimal click-then-answer task 0/5 in EXP-INTEL-37982024058, and the anonymous proxy was capped and unstable). All six lanes currently hold an unfinished PREFREEZE experiment and none is idle; each active mandate already maps onto the correct work: Product->B1, Runtime->B2, Intel->B3, Graph->blocking delta-repair evidence, Physics and Frontier->two capped orthogonal probes that already carry pre-freeze attainability and park-if-unsatisfiable clauses. After an explicit cognitive reset per flagged lane, I CONTINUE all six, because in each case the inherited direction still wins on merits against the available alternatives. Crucially, I do NOT authorize any expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON four-arm execution this cycle: none of the three readiness conditions holds, so Product, Runtime and Intel are funded to REMOVE the blockers, not to run the flagship benchmark. I also decline to reopen the parked four-anchor D1V freshness route (single-anchor, transport-coupled, degenerate by the lane's own verdict), to fund another Web next-action estimator, or to authorize a third rerun of the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST certificate. Two of the six lanes are flagged for local-attractor behavior (graph, physics, runtime); the flag is treated as diagnostic only and each reset confirms continuation.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout is in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (rc=124, no external reconnaissance or synthesis produced this cycle); its brief is explicitly not scientific evidence. Its per-lane candidate_directions are mechanically derived from each lane's existing active mandate and parent handoff, so they carried no independent external signal and changed no decision. I used them only as a checklist to confirm I had the correct claim_id and inherited handoff per lane, and I cross-checked each against the machine snapshot, claim_state.effective_event_by_claim and the 10-10 global audit. The Scout's three questions_for_director were addressed directly: the strongest blocker on the residual-novelty cost claim is B2 (no non-ceiling, treatment/comparator-distinguishing task bank), which is why Runtime is funded to certify it; the repeated measurement-repair work should be consolidated once in Runtime (task-bank certificate) and Product (carrier promotion) instead of being rediscovered as MEASUREMENT_INVALID across lanes; and if no parent handoff existed the outside-view choice would be the same three-gate sequence (shipped executable carrier, non-ceiling bank, capable agent) before any economics run. No Scout-identified external item required deep Intel verification because Scout produced none; Intel's bounded external capability-envelope check is retained as part of its own mandate.

inherited_next_question: Now that the pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate is unsatisfiable on the mandatory-discovery deterministic credential-free REST substrate class (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED both at the 1.0 correctness ceiling at novelty >= 0.5 in families F1 and F2, so the parameterized treatment cannot save http_requests and the frozen cost/novelty test is non-discriminating), the materially orthogonal question is: on a programmatic, budget-stable, credential-free model endpoint (the prerequisite Intel showed is missing, EXP-INTEL-37973264582), can the frozen four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark (same model/tools/budget: COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER, with the parameterized mechanism carrier bound to git blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) produce genuine behavioral variance (COLD success_rate meaningfully below the 1.0 ceiling) and, if so, does the SPIDER arm beat COLD, INSTRUCTIONS and RETRIEVAL on cost per SUCCESSFUL task on an honest counter-only metric (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts, excluding latency_ms/1000)? If no such endpoint can be provisioned, the fallback is a credential-free substrate engineered for ASYMMETRIC discovery (multi-task sessions where one-time session/resource/schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks), tested against the same certificate and the same counter-only novelty-monotonicity criterion; a fourth re-run of the mandatory-discovery deterministic REST certificate is explicitly excluded.
